arxiv-2110-12407.title: Defining new linear functions in tame expansions of the real ordered additive group
arxiv-2110-12407.creator: Alex Savatovsky
arxiv-2110-12407.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Alex Savatovsky. We explore semibounded expansions of arbitrary ordered groups; namely, expansions that do not define a field on the whole universe. For ℛ = ⟨ ℛ , < , + , … ⟩ \cal R=\langle R,<,+,\dots\rangle , a semibounded o-minimal structure and P ⊆ R P\subseteq R a set satisfying certain tameness conditions, we discuss under which conditions ⟨ ℛ , 𝒫 ⟩ \langle\cal R,P\rangle defines total linear functions that are not definable in R.

arxiv-2111-02663.title: Charged rotating black strings
arxiv-2111-02663.creator: in Einsteinian cubic gravity
arxiv-2111-02663.description: Abstract We construct, for the first time, charged rotating black string solutions in four-dimensional Einsteinian cubic gravity, which are asymptotically anti–de Sitter. By assuming that the solutions are completely regular at the horizon and studying their near-horizon behavior, we find some thermodynamic properties, which can be accessed analytically.

arxiv-2112-06527.title: Recursive construction of a Nash equilibrium in a two-player nonzero-sum stopping game with asymmetric information
arxiv-2112-06527.creator: Royi Jacobovic
arxiv-2112-06527.description: Abstract We study a discrete-time finite-horizon two-players nonzero-sum stopping game where the filtration of Player 1 is richer than the filtration of Player 2. A major difficulty which is caused by the information asymmetry is that Player 2 may not know whether Player 1 has already stopped the game or not.

arxiv-2206-08943.title: Topological twists of massive SQCD, Part I
arxiv-2206-08943.creator: Johannes Aspman, Elias Furrer, Jan Manschot School of Mathematics, Trinity College, Dublin 2, Ireland Hamilton Mathematical Institute, Trinity College, Dublin 2
arxiv-2206-08943.description: Abstract We consider topological twists of four-dimensional 𝒩 = 2 \mathcal{N}=2 supersymmetric QCD with gauge group SU ( 2 ) (2) and N f ≤ 3 N_{f}\leq 3 fundamental hypermultiplets. The twists are labelled by a choice of background fluxes for the flavour group, which provides an infinite family of topological partition functions.

arxiv-2403-03901.title: A notion of s s -fractional mass for 1 1 -currents in higher codimension
arxiv-2403-03901.creator: M. Cicalese, T. Heilmann, A. kubin, F. Onoue, M. Ponsiglione
arxiv-2403-03901.description: Abstract . In this paper we propose a notion of s s -fractional mass for 1 1 -currents in ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} . Such a notion generalizes the notion of s s -fractional perimeters for sets in the plane to higher codimension one-dimensional singularities.

arxiv-2405-02993.title: Polarization Purity and Dispersion Characteristics of Nested Antiresonant Nodeless Hollow-Core Optical Fiber at Near- and Short-wave-IR Wavelengths for Quantum Communications Journal: opticajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2405-02993.creator: Ivi Afxenti, 1 Lijun Yu, 1 Taylor Shields, 1 Daniele Faccio, 2 Thomas Bradley, 3,4 Lucia Caspani, 5 Matteo Clerici, 1,6 and Adetunmise C. Dada 2,*
arxiv-2405-02993.description: Abstract Advancements in quantum communication and sensing require improved optical transmission that ensures excellent state purity and reduced losses. While free-space optical communication is often preferred, its use becomes challenging over long distances due to beam divergence, atmospheric absorption, scattering, and turbulence, among other factors.

arxiv-2409-11984.title: Multi-set spectral clustering of time-evolving networks using the supra-Laplacian
arxiv-2409-11984.creator: Gary Froyland, Manu Kalia, Péter Koltai
arxiv-2409-11984.description: Abstract Complex time-varying networks are prominent models for a wide variety of spatiotemporal phenomena. The functioning of networks depends crucially on their connectivity, yet reliable techniques for learning communities in time-evolving networks remain elusive. We adapt successful spectral techniques from continuous-time dynamics on manifolds to the graph setting to fill this gap.

arxiv-2507-18250.title: A note on Duality and the Atiyah–Hirzebruch spectral sequence
arxiv-2507-18250.creator: Maximilian Hans
arxiv-2507-18250.description: Abstract . We show that, for a finite spectrum X X , the Spanier–Whitehead duality isomorphism induces an isomorphism between the cohomological and homological Atiyah–Hirzebruch spectral sequences. As an application, it follows that Poincaré duality for a Poincaré duality complex, which is oriented over a ring spectrum ℰ \mathscr{E} , induces an isomorphism between the two spectral sequences. 1.

arxiv-2509-14047.title: Dissipativity-Based Data-Driven Decentralized Control of Interconnected Systems
arxiv-2509-14047.creator: Taiki Nakano, Ahmed Aboudonia, Jaap Eising, Andrea Martinelli, Florian Dörfler, John Lygeros
arxiv-2509-14047.description: Abstract We propose data-driven decentralized control algorithms for stabilizing interconnected systems. We first derive a data-driven condition to synthesize a local controller that ensures the dissipativity of the local subsystems. Then, we propose data-driven decentralized stability conditions for the global system based on the dissipativity of each local system.

arxiv-2511-02098.title: Screened Thin-Target Bremsstrahlung with Partially-Ionized High-Z Species
arxiv-2511-02098.creator: S. Guinchard, Y. Savoye-Peysson, J. Decker
arxiv-2511-02098.description: Abstract Bremsstrahlung emission remains a cornerstone process in the characterization of electron dynamics in diverse high-energy environments. In particular, the accurate description of thin-target electron-ion bremsstrahlung in the presence of high- Z Z species requires careful treatment of atomic screening effects, especially when atoms are partially ionized.

pmc-10517391.creator: Afsaneh Sadeghzadeh Bazargan, Anahita Tabavar, Masoumeh Roohaninasab, Zahra Naeimaei Ali, Zeynab Tavana, Seyede Saba Mostafavi Montazeri, Alireza Jafarzadeh

pmc-10670850.title: Cancer Center Staff Satisfaction: Descriptive Results of a Canadian Study
pmc-10670850.creator: Rajiv Samant, Ege Babadagli, Selena Laprade, Gordon Emil Locke, Yuxin Zhang, Angela McNeil, Julie Renaud, Elisabeth Cisa-Paré, Jessica Chan, Jiheon Song, Joanne Meng
pmc-10670850.description: Caring for cancer patients is generally considered very rewarding work, but it can also be stressful and demanding. Therefore, it is important for oncology healthcare professionals to feel satisfied with their work environment in order to provide the best care possible.

pmc-11434620.title: Local volume concentration, packing domains, and scaling properties of chromatin
pmc-11434620.creator: Marcelo A Carignano, Martin Kroeger, Luay M Almassalha, Vasundhara Agrawal, Wing Shun Li, Emily M Pujadas-Liwag, Rikkert J Nap, Vadim Backman, Igal Szleifer, Bin Zhang, Marcelo A Carignano, Martin Kroeger, Luay Almassalha, Vasundhara Agrawal, Wing Shun Li, Emily M Pujadas, Rikkert J Nap, Vadim Backm
pmc-11434620.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). We propose the Self Returning Excluded Volume (SR-EV) model for the structure of chromatin based on stochastic rules and physical interactions. The SR-EV rules of return generate conformationally defined domains observed by single-cell imaging techniques. From nucleosome to chromosome scales, the model captures the overall chromatin organization as a corrugated system, with dense and dilute regions alternating in a manner that resembles the mixing of two disordered bi-continuous phases.

pmc-11477342.title: Assessment of Skimmed Milk Flocculation for Bacterial Enrichment from Water Samples, and Benchmarking of DNA Extraction and 16S rRNA Databases for Metagenomics
pmc-11477342.creator: Deyan Donchev, Ivan Stoikov, Antonia Diukendjieva, Ivan N Ivanov, Nicole Hansmeier
pmc-11477342.description: Water samples for bacterial microbiome studies undergo biomass concentration, DNA extraction, and taxonomic identification steps. Through benchmarking, we studied the applicability of skimmed milk flocculation (SMF) for bacterial enrichment, an adapted in-house DNA extraction protocol, and six 16S rRNA databases (16S-DBs).

pmc-11517541.title: AI-Enhanced Allergy Diagnostics: Streamlining Healthcare and Reducing Costs
pmc-11517541.creator: P J Łukasiewicz
pmc-11517541.description: Issue/ProblemWHO projects a shortfall of 10 million health workers by 2030. One area particularly lacking technological support is allergy diagnostics. The World Allergy Organization recognizes skin tests as the gold standard for allergy diagnostics, yet these tests are still manually assessed. General practitioners lack the time and tools, leading them to focus on treating the symptoms without addressing the causes.

Prepared mangaba powder has important amounts of phenolic compounds, vitamin C, dietary fiber and oligosaccharides.

pmc-12677677.title: Selective Lithium Recovery via Stepwise Transition Metal Crystallization in a Natural Deep Eutectic Solvent
pmc-12677677.creator: Jingxiu Wang, Jodie Yuwono, Yan Wang, Yanqiu Lyu, Sailin Liu, Tony Hall, Rong Zeng, Jianfeng Mao, Zaiping Guo

Deep eutectic solvents (DESs) have emerged as promising green alternatives to conventional leaching agents, yet challenges persist in preferential Li selectivity and process scalability.

pmc-13064353.title: Costoclavicular Brachial Plexus Block for Upper Limb Procedures: A Narrative Review of Efficacy and Safety
pmc-13064353.creator: Richa Kewalramani, Anuradha Vaswani, Khushboo Bairwa, Rajashree Munavalli, Sushil K Bhati
pmc-13064353.description: Regional anesthesia techniques for upper limb surgery continue to evolve to improve block reliability while minimizing approach-specific complications. pmc-13577404.title: HMOX2-driven crosstalk between vascular aging and heart failure: A multimodal bioinformatics and explainable machine learning approach with experimental validation
pmc-13577404.creator: Jinze Li, Guiting Zhou, Qiaochu Wang, Zhixuan Song, Jiantao Liu, Changzao Shen, Chuanjin Luo, Dawei Wang
pmc-13577404.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeThe molecular mechanisms linking vascular aging (VA) and heart failure (HF) remain elusive, hindering therapeutic strategies for their comorbidity. This study aimed to identify key biomarkers and pathways potentially involved in VA-HF synergy using integrative computational approaches.MethodsWe analyzed the GSE57338 dataset (136 controls, 177 HF samples) to identify HF-associated differentially expressed genes (DEGs) and constructed a weighted gene co-expression network (WGCNA). Vascular aging-related targets were retrieved from GeneCards (n = 16,243).

pmc-13578430.title: First cleavage signatures define a temporal trade-off and predict embryo fitness
pmc-13578430.creator: Daphne Norma Crasta, Si Won Lee, Jolene Fredrickson, Theodore Trejo, Nadeem Ghani Khan, Shama Prasada Kabekkodu, Satish Kumar Adiga, Yulian Zhao, Guruprasad Kalthur, Nagarajan Kannan
pmc-13578430.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Early embryonic development is marked by substantial variability in cleavage dynamics, yet the extent to which first cleavage (FC) features relate to subsequent developmental progression remains incompletely defined. Using parthenogenetic (haploid and diploid) and fertilized embryos from Swiss albino mice, we combined time-lapse imaging with mechanistic analyses to define a novel FC-state grading system (FC-I to FC-IV) based on cleavage symmetry, fragmentation, and correction of the cleavage axis.

uslaw-usc-t51-s30307.title: 51 U.S.C. § 30307 — Requirement for independent cost analysis
uslaw-usc-t51-s30307.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t51-s30307.description: United States Code, Title 51 (National And Commercial Space Programs); Chapter 303 (Contracting And Procurement). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Definition of Implementation.— In this section, the term “implementation” means all activity in the life cycle of a project after preliminary design, independent assessment of the preliminary design, and approval to proceed into implementation, including critical design, development, certification, launch, operations.
